name: Open Studio Hours
summary: A public invitation identity that makes the act of entering a creative space feel simple and concrete.

palette.name: Background
palette.evidence: Native Office page/sheet white ground; explicit design choice retaining the reading surface.

palette.name: Text
palette.evidence: used style Normal explicit text color

palette.name: Studio red
palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/styles.xml: style SAI, style PPress, style IStudio; text.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style SSubtitle.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style F23Art.

recognitionRules: Use oversized black OPEN and red STUDIO in Impact, with alternating black/red irregular open frames beneath the invitation.
Keep category and practical details in compact Arial text.
Give date, location and attendance action a distinct block.
Leave enough negative space that the invitation works from a distance.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Come in. See what is taking shape.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use OPEN STUDIO HOURS as a bold two-line Impact wordmark with HOURS in small Arial. The typography is the sign; no door pictogram.
invariants: Use oversized black OPEN and red STUDIO in Impact, with alternating black/red irregular open frames beneath the invitation.
Keep category and practical details in compact Arial text.
Give date, location and attendance action a distinct block.
adaptations: A street poster emphasizes the invitation; a digital card adds access details.
Keep the word OPEN legible at the smallest intended size.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Impact is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
